title: Industry-University Collaboration and Commercializing Chinese Corporate Innovation
authors: David H. Hsu; Po-Hsuan Hsu; Kaiguo Zhou; Tong Zhou
eligible_reason: No staggered binary treatment. Regressors are firms' trailing five-year industry-university collaboration experience (patiuc/papiuc as log counts or a non-absorbing any-collaboration dummy) with firm, province-year and industry-year FE and a block of time-varying firm controls; Tables 4-6 and 10 add interactions with firm characteristics. Panel regressions, not a DiD/event-study design.
design_notes: reghdfe Y_log patiuc_{d,log} [ttoutput_log pattotal_log rdratio + 11 firm controls], absorb(panelid provyear induyear) vce(cluster panelid). patiuc_d = 1[patiuc > 0] can switch on and off (rolling five-year window) and is not an adoption indicator. SAS construction code plus Stata regression code; the NBS firm census ('industrynew') and the constructed BASELINE/CONDI/CHANNEL/TECHCOMP datasets are not included; only 'Shared dataset.dta' with the key IUC and innovation variables is provided.

ineligible_specs.reason: continuous / non-absorbing regressor, time-varying controls; not a DiD

data_files: Shared dataset.dta (key variables only; regression datasets missing)
software_notes: SAS for data construction, Stata (reghdfe) for regressions
screener_notes: Full-text 'staggered' / Cengiz et al. hits likely refer to a robustness discussion in the text, not to code in the package.
